latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — free AI video editing tool for quick, watermark-free exports.

- Instantly edit and export short video clips (under 3 minutes recommended) to 1080p MP4 by describing the desired result in chat.
- No timeline dragging or export settings needed; just upload your video and specify edits like trimming, overlays, or aspect ratio changes.
- Anonymous users receive 100 free credits (valid 7 days) and can edit videos online without watermarks.
- Real-time session management, cloud GPU rendering pipeline, and multi-language prompt support.
- Supports multiple video, image, and audio formats for upload and export.
